name: Zynx
look: a pastel pillow-pouch sprite with mint cheeks and sparkly eyes, peeking out of a round mint tin, its lid a hat
entry: Compact and discreet, Zynx hides inside trainers' pockets. A single touch gives an instant jolt of icy clarity and focus.
how: Wild: uncommon in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
It learns Lip Tingle at level 17.
